//locales: Each locale needs a config/copy.<locale>.json. `dir` there drives RTL.
//slides: Order is the store order. `raw` is a filename in rawDir. `layout`: standard | full-bleed | angled | zoom. `zoom` needs `focus` (fractions of the raw image: x/y are the centre, scale is the magnification). `device`: iphone | pixel.

slides.//focus: Zoom always crops horizontally. Aim at a band whose content is centred (a card, a control row), not at full-width body text, or words get cut at the edges.

//targets: Exact export pixels. Play gets JPEG because JPEG cannot carry an alpha channel, which is how the no-transparency rule is satisfied by construction rather than by post-processing.
//featureGraphic: Google Play only. Exactly 1024x500, no transparency.
